name: PublishYourSaaS

sources.title: Homepage — 'List Your SaaS Today', DR-47 backlink pitch, 238k monthly page views (Cloudflare-measured)
Pricing — Free (nofollow unless badge verified, checked every 24h) / Starter $9.99 / Advanced $49.99

conditions: Free listing is NOFOLLOW by default; the PublishYourSaaS badge must be verified to activate the dofollow link — badge is re-checked every 24 hours and removing it removes the dofollow
Free listings wait for manual staff review: 2–3 weeks; one free launch per product (free relaunches allowed)
requirements: Sign in required — Google or GitHub for dashboard access and listing management
Paid tiers activate only after confirmed payment
preparation: SaaS name, URL, description, categories, logo/screenshot
Badge embed if using free + wanting dofollow (and keep it permanently)

Plan: Free $0 / Starter $9.99 one-time (3 permanent dofollow, immediate publish, 30-day Premium Partners homepage visibility, relaunches $5.99) / Advanced $49.99 one-time (4 dofollow, newsletter feature, up to 3 dofollow guest posts, SEO title/meta/keywords, relaunches $19.99)
Banner advertises '40% off on all plans using promocode DISCOUNT_CODE' — literal placeholder code shown on site
workflow: Sign in with Google or GitHub
Fill the listing and pick a plan
Free: wait 2–3 weeks for manual approval; keep the badge live for dofollow
Paid: activates immediately after checkout confirms
watchFor: The free dofollow is conditional forever — badge is re-verified every 24 hours, not once
Relaunches are free on the free plan but cost extra on paid plans ($5.99 / $19.99 each)
Discount banner shows a literal 'DISCOUNT_CODE' placeholder — try it, but don't count on it
Daily 'boost' gamification ranks products within their plan; paid placement stays protected — free listings can never outrank paid
'Claim a Listing' exists for pre-listed products
countsAsLive: Listing page on publishyoursaas.com/browse-all and the /tech-products directory with its plan label (Free/Starter/Advanced) and domain link
unknowns: Whether free listings are searchable/indexed equally with paid
